constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_archive_bytes_check CHECK ((archive_bytes >= 0))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_duration_s_check CHECK ((duration_s >= 0))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_environment_check CHECK ((environment = ANY (ARRAY['local'::text, 'staging'::text, 'production'::text])))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_error_code_check CHECK (((char_length(error_code) <= 64) AND (error_code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'::text)))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_failed_has_code CHECK (((status <> 'failed'::text) OR (error_code IS NOT NULL)))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_manifest_counts_check CHECK (((manifest_counts IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(manifest_counts) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((manifest_counts)::text) <= 65536))))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_object_key_check CHECK (((char_length(object_key) <= 200) AND (object_key ~ '^[a-z0-9-]+/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{6}Z\.tar\.age$'::text)))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_ok_has_archive CHECK (((status <> 'ok'::text) OR ((object_key IS NOT NULL) AND (archive_bytes IS NOT NULL))))
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint ops.backup_runs.backup_runs_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['ok'::text, 'failed'::text])))
constraint ops.error_event_overflow.error_event_overflow_dropped_check CHECK ((dropped >= 0))
constraint ops.error_event_overflow.error_event_overflow_pkey PRIMARY KEY (day)
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_count_check CHECK ((count >= 1))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_digest_check CHECK ((digest ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'::text))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_environment_check CHECK ((environment = ANY (ARRAY['development'::text, 'test'::text, 'e2e'::text, 'ci'::text, 'staging'::text, 'production'::text])))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_error_code_check CHECK ((error_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,40}$'::text))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_error_name_check CHECK ((error_name ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.$-]{1,80}$'::text))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_fingerprint_check CHECK ((fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_fingerprint_day UNIQUE (fingerprint, occurred_on)
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_frames_check CHECK ((cardinality(frames) <= 20))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_message_check CHECK ((char_length(message) <= 500))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_method_check CHECK ((method ~ '^[A-Z]{1,10}$'::text))
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint ops.error_events.error_events_release_check CHECK ((release ~ '^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$'::text))

constraint ops.error_events.error_events_route_type_check CHECK ((route_type = ANY (ARRAY['render'::text, 'route'::text, 'action'::text, 'proxy'::text])))

policy public.api_key_usage_daily.api_key_usage_owner_admin cmd=* permissive=t roles=authenticated using=(EXISTS ( SELECT 1    FROM membership   WHERE ((memberships.tenant_id = api_key_usage_daily.tenant_id) AND (memberships.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (memberships.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text]))))) check=(EXISTS ( SELECT 1    FROM membership   WHERE ((memberships.tenant_id = api_key_usage_daily.tenant_id) AND (memberships.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (memberships.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])))))
policy public.api_keys.api_keys_owner_admin cmd=* permissive=t roles=authenticated using=(EXISTS ( SELECT 1    FROM membership   WHERE ((memberships.tenant_id = api_keys.tenant_id) AND (memberships.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (memberships.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text]))))) check=(EXISTS ( SELECT 1    FROM membership   WHERE ((memberships.tenant_id = api_keys.tenant_id) AND (memberships.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (memberships.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])))))
policy public.audit_logs.audit_logs_insert_member cmd=a permissive=t roles=authenticated using=- check=(tenant_id IN ( SELECT current_user_tenant_ids() AS current_user_tenant_ids))
policy public.audit_logs.audit_logs_select_owner_admin cmd=r permissive=t roles=authenticated using=(EXISTS ( SELECT 1    FROM membership   WHERE ((memberships.tenant_id = audit_logs.tenant_id) AND (memberships.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (memberships.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text]))))) check=-

trigger ops.jobs.jobs_message_dead CREATE TRIGGER jobs_message_dead AFTER UPDATE OF status ON ops.jobs FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'dead'::text) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'dead'::text) AND (new.kind = 'message.send'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ops.message_job_dead()
trigger public.audit_logs.audit_logs_actor_guard CREATE TRIGGER audit_logs_actor_guard BEFORE INSERT ON public.audit_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_logs_actor_guard()
trigger public.communication_queue.communication_queue_enqueue_job CREATE TRIGGER communication_queue_enqueue_job AFTER INSERT ON public.communication_queue FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ops.communication_queue_enqueue_job()
trigger public.communication_queue.communication_queue_scrub_payload CREATE TRIGGER communication_queue_scrub_payload BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.communication_queue FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION communication_queue_scrub_payload()
trigger public.memberships.memberships_profile_update_guard CREATE TRIGGER memberships_profile_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.memberships FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION memberships_profile_update_guard()
trigger public.payments.payments_actor_guard CREATE TRIGGER payments_actor_guard BEFORE INSERT ON public.payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.payments_actor_guard()
trigger public.referrals.referrals_target_update_guard CREATE TRIGGER referrals_target_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.referrals FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION referrals_target_update_guard()
